dishes.name: Lemon and Poppy Seed Loaf
dishes.title: Lemon and poppy seed yogurt loaf with Greek yogurt
dishes.method: Slice a portion of the loaf. Serve with a generous dollop of fresh Greek yogurt on the side.
dishes.why: We brought the Sunday traybake dream forward to Wednesday to brighten the kitchen while it's still usable.

dishes.name: Odalric's Jam and Egg Toast
dishes.title: Blackcurrant jam on toast with boiled eggs
dishes.method: Boil the eggs for 7 minutes. Toast the bread and spread with blackcurrant jam. Serve together.
dishes.why: Odalric has his own breakfast routine, but we've added eggs to ensure the coach's protein anchor rule is met.

dishes.name: Garlic Chicken and Couscous Bowl
dishes.title: Lemon and garlic chicken with roasted courgettes and giant couscous
dishes.method: Combine a portion of the warm roasted chicken and courgettes with the herby giant couscous. Top with fresh parsley.
dishes.why: Courgette is our loud vegetable today, providing a fresh crunch against the garlic chicken.

dishes.name: Beef and Lentil Keema
dishes.title: Beef and brown lentil keema with roasted potatoes
dishes.method: Serve the warm beef and lentil keema over the roasted potatoes. Stir through the fresh spinach so it wilts in the heat.
dishes.why: A hearty, warm dinner that anchors the day with beef and iron-rich lentils.

dishes.name: Odalric's Jam and Egg Toast
dishes.title: Blackcurrant jam on toast with boiled eggs
dishes.method: Boil the eggs for 7 minutes. Toast the bread and spread with jam.
dishes.why: Easy to eat while Odalric stands by the window watching the hallway being painted.

dishes.name: Lemon and Poppy Seed Loaf
dishes.title: Lemon and poppy seed yogurt loaf with Greek yogurt
dishes.method: Slice the loaf and serve with Greek yogurt. Can be eaten by hand if the table is busy.
dishes.why: A portable breakfast for a day when the kitchen table is out of action.

dishes.name: Reheated Beef Keema Bowl
dishes.title: Beef and lentil keema with potatoes
dishes.method: Reheat the keema and potatoes in a large frying pan with a splash of water until piping hot. Serve in bowls.
dishes.why: A bowl-based lunch that doesn't require a table to enjoy.

dishes.name: Warm Chicken and Herb Couscous
dishes.title: Roasted chicken and courgettes with giant couscous
dishes.method: Reheat the chicken, courgettes, and couscous together in a pan. Finish with a squeeze of fresh lemon.
dishes.why: Warm elements are essential for dinner, even on a busy DIY day.

dishes.name: Final Lemon Loaf Breakfast
dishes.title: Lemon and poppy seed yogurt loaf with Greek yogurt
dishes.method: The final slices of the yogurt loaf served with fresh Greek yogurt.
dishes.why: Completing the batch of the house-requested lemon treat.

dishes.name: Odalric's Jam and Egg Toast
dishes.title: Blackcurrant jam on toast with boiled eggs
dishes.method: Boil the eggs and prepare the jam toast as usual.
dishes.why: Consistent protein-fuelled start for Odalric's morning.

dishes.name: Friday Keema Lunch
dishes.title: Beef and lentil keema with potatoes
dishes.method: Pan-reheat the last of the keema and potatoes. Garnish with fresh coriander.
dishes.why: Using the last of the beef batch for a high-protein lunch.

dishes.name: Pan-Seared Pork and Couscous
dishes.title: Quick garlic pork medallions with herby giant couscous
dishes.method: Sear the pork medallions in oil with crushed garlic for 3-4 minutes per side. Reheat the couscous in the same pan to pick up the juices.
dishes.why: A fresh-cooked protein to end the stretch, utilizing the remaining giant couscous batch.

preparations.title: Lemon and Poppy Seed Breakfast Loaf
preparations.method: Whisk yogurt, eggs, honey, and lemon zest. Fold in flour and poppy seeds. Bake at 180°C for 45 minutes until golden.

preparations.title: Garlic and Lemon Roasted Chicken and Courgettes
preparations.method: Toss chicken and sliced courgettes with oil, crushed garlic, and lemon juice. Roast at 200°C for 30 minutes.

preparations.title: Beef and Brown Lentil Keema
preparations.method: Brown the beef. Add lentils, cumin, and stock. Simmer for 25 minutes until lentils are soft and the mixture is thick and brown.

preparations.title: Lemon and Herb Giant Couscous
preparations.method: Boil couscous in salted water for 8 minutes. Drain and toss with lemon juice and oregano.

preparations.title: Simple Roasted Potato Wedges
preparations.method: Cut potatoes into wedges. Toss with oil and salt. Roast at 200°C for 35 minutes until crisp.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Oven on. Prep the yogurt loaf and get it in first. Chop potatoes and courgettes; roast them on separate trays with the chicken. Start the beef keema on the hob. Boil the giant couscous last. Box everything once cooled.
